endorsements.quote: Additionally, using standardized reporting frameworks such as the Checklist for Artificial Intelligence in Medical Imaging is vital for achieving transparency and reproducibility.

In conclusion, for AI to be adequately used in the diagnosis of IPMN, prospective investigations must highlight standardized imaging protocols and large multicenter clinical trials to establish applied significance.

unlisted_practices: Conduct prospective, multicenter validation of AI tools for IPMN diagnosis to confirm reliability and generalizability before routine clinical use.
Standardize radiomics workflows, including image segmentation approaches and data balancing, for AI-based IPMN diagnosis.
Incorporate validated AI tools into international IPMN management guidelines once they predict malignant transformation with greater accuracy.
